units.title: Good morning!
units.topic: 人与社会 · 日常问候与字母入门
units.grammar_focus: 常见问候语与 be 动词 am / are 初识
grammar_points: 英语 26 个字母 A–H 的规范书写、大小写占格及元音字母 A/E 发音规律
不同时段问候语搭配：Good morning / afternoon / evening! 及其回应
人称代词 I 与 you 对应的 be 动词搭配（I am = I'm；How are you?）
缩写形式与常见英文缩略词辨析（HB, CD, BBC 等）
key_vocab: fine adj. 健康的；美好的
key_patterns: Good morning, Helen! / Good afternoon, Eric!
How are you? I'm fine, thanks. / I'm OK.

units.title: What's this in English?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 身边物品与字母拼读
units.grammar_focus: 不定冠词 a / an 与指示代词 this / that
grammar_points: 不定冠词 a 与 an 的核心区分：看单词读音的首音素（元音音素前用 an，如 an orange）
指示代词 this（近指）与 that（远指）提问单数物品，答句主语须用 it 替代
介词 in 表示“用某种语言”（in English）与动词 spell 祈使句（Spell it, please.）
字母 I–R 的规范书写及常见缩略词（P, NBA, kg）
key_vocab: in prep. 用（某种语言）；在……里
English n. 英语 adj. 英格兰的；英语的
orange n. 橙子 adj. 橙色的
jacket n. 夹克衫；短上衣
spell v. 用字母拼；拼写
key_patterns: What's this in English? It's an orange.
What's that in English? It's a map.
Spell it, please. M-A-P.

units.title: What color is it?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 颜色描述与字母收官
units.grammar_focus: 定冠词 the 的特指用法与 What color 句型
grammar_points: 特殊疑问词组 What color 对颜色提问：What color is + 单数名词 / it?
定冠词 the 用于特指双方都知道的或上文提到过的事物（The key is yellow.）
表颜色的形容词作表语时前面不加冠词（It's red. 而非 It's a red.）
字母 S–Z 的书写、五个元音字母（A, E, I, O, U）汇总及缩略词（S/M/L, UFO, CCTV）
key_vocab: brown adj.&n. 棕色（的）；褐色（的）
see v. 理解；明白；看见
key_patterns: What color is it? It's black and white.
The key is yellow.
I can say my ABCs.

units.title: My name's Gina.
units.topic: 人与社会 · 结交新友与个人信息
units.grammar_focus: be 动词一般现在时与形容词性物主代词
grammar_points: be 动词（am / is / are）的人称搭配口诀及否定句（be + not）、一般疑问句（be 提前）
形容词性物主代词（my, your, his, her）后必须接名词，不能单独使用
中英文姓名顺序差异：first name（名）与 last / family name（姓）中考高频辨析
基数词 0–9 的读写与电话号码询问句型（What's your telephone number?）
key_vocab: nice adj. 令人愉快的；宜人的
key_patterns: What's your name? My name's Gina. / I'm Gina.
Nice to meet you! Nice to meet you, too.
What's her telephone number? It's 281-9176.

units.title: This is my sister.
units.topic: 人与自我 · 家庭成员与亲属介绍
units.grammar_focus: 指示代词单复数（this/that, these/those）与名词复数
grammar_points: 指示代词单复数对应关系：this → these（近指），that → those（远指）
Who 引导的特殊疑问句询问人物身份，注意答句中人称代词主格（he/she/they）的匹配
可数名词复数规则变化（直接加 -s；以 s/x/ch/sh 结尾加 -es 等）
介绍他人时的固定句式：This is... / These are...（不能用 He is... 代替电话用语外）
key_vocab: grandparent n. 祖父（母）；外祖父（母）
key_patterns: This is my sister Kate. Those are my parents.
Who's she? She's my cousin.
Here is a nice photo of my family.

units.title: Is this your pencil?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 学习用品与失物招领
units.grammar_focus: 名词性物主代词与含 be 动词的一般疑问句
grammar_points: 名词性物主代词（mine, yours, his, hers）独立使用，等价于“形容词性物主代词 + 名词”
Is this/that...? 与 Are these/those...? 的简略回答须用 it 或 they 替代指示代词
礼貌打扰与致谢表达：Excuse me, ... / Thank you for your help. / You're welcome.
失物招领启事（Lost and Found）格式与高频动词短语 ask...for... / call...at...
key_patterns: Is this your pencil? Yes, it is. It's mine.
Are these your books? No, they aren't. They're hers.
Please call Mary at 495-3539.

units.title: Where's my schoolbag?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 居家房间与物品方位
units.grammar_focus: Where 特殊疑问句与方位介词 in / on / under
grammar_points: Where + is/are + 名词? 询问人或物品位置，回答时注意单复数主语（It's / They're）一致
方位介词核心区分：in（在……里面）、on（在……表面上）、under（在……正下方）
并列连词 and（表顺承/并列）与 but（表转折）在描述房间整洁时的运用
名词所有格（-'s）初步接触及介词短语作表语的语序
key_vocab: where adv. 在哪里；到哪里
tidy adj. 整洁的；井井有条的
key_patterns: Where's my schoolbag? It's under the table.
Where are my books? They're on the sofa.
I'm tidy, but Gina is not.

units.title: Do you have a soccer ball?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 体育用品与课余运动
units.grammar_focus: 实义动词 have 的一般现在时与助动词 do / does
grammar_points: have / has 的人称变化：第三人称单数主语用 has，其余用 have
含实义动词的一般疑问句与否定句需借助助动词 do / does（does 后动词必须还原为原形）
Let's + 动词原形（提建议）及肯定/否定回应（That sounds good / interesting.）
系动词 sound 后接形容词作表语，与 play + 球类名词（不加定冠词 the）的中考考点
key_vocab: boring adj. 没趣的；令人厌倦的
relaxing adj. 轻松的；令人放松的
key_patterns: Do you have a baseball? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Does she have a tennis ball? Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
Let's play basketball! That sounds great.

units.title: Do you like bananas?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 饮食习惯与健康生活
units.grammar_focus: 实义动词 like 一般现在时与可数/不可数名词
grammar_points: 动词 like 的一般现在时变化（likes / don't like / doesn't like）与三单动词 -s/-es 规则
可数名词（banana, tomato, strawberry）的复数不规则及以 -o/-y 结尾的变化规则
不可数名词（milk, bread, rice）无复数形式，作主语时谓语用单数；兼类词（chicken, salad, ice-cream）辨析
一日三餐名词前一般不加冠词（for breakfast / lunch / dinner）及询问饮食偏好句型
key_vocab: dinner n. （中午或晚上吃的）正餐
key_patterns: Do you like salad? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
She likes strawberries, but she doesn't like tomatoes.
What do you like for breakfast?

units.title: How much are these socks?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 购物交际与服饰价格
units.grammar_focus: How much 询问价格与基数词 10–31
grammar_points: How much is + 单数名词? 与 How much are + 复数名词? 询问价格，答句用 It's / They're...
成双成对衣物名词（socks, shoes, trousers, shorts）作主语时谓语动词用复数，可用 a pair of 修饰
基数词 10–31 构词规律：-teen（十几）与 -ty（几十）重音与拼写辨析
购物情景交际用语：Can I help you? / What color do you want? / I'll take it.
key_vocab: dollar n. 元（美国、加拿大等国的货币单位）
key_patterns: How much is this T-shirt? It's seven dollars.
How much are these socks? They're two dollars.
Can I help you? Yes, please. I need a sweater for school.

units.title: When is your birthday?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 生日日期与校园活动
units.grammar_focus: 序数词构成、日期表达与名词所有格 -'s
grammar_points: 基数词变序数词口诀（一二三特殊记，八去 t 九去 e，ve 要用 f 替，ty 变 tie）及缩写（1st, 2nd, 3rd）
时间介词核心考点：in + 月份/季节/年份，on + 具体某一天（My birthday is on May 2nd.）
名词所有格 -'s 表示所属关系：单数名词加 -'s，以 s 结尾的复数名词加 '，两人共有在后加 -'s
When 引导的特殊疑问句询问时间及 How old 询问年龄
key_vocab: busy adj. 忙碌的；无暇的
key_patterns: When is your birthday? My birthday is on October 2nd.
When is Alice's birthday? Her birthday is in August.
We have some interesting and fun things for you this term.

units.title: My favorite subject is science.
units.cn_title: 我最喜欢的科目是科学。
units.topic: 人与自我 · 校园学科与学习偏好
units.grammar_focus: What / Why / Who / When 特殊疑问句汇总
grammar_points: 特殊疑问词体系梳理：What（事物/科目）、Why（原因，用 because 回答）、Who（人物）、When（时间）
英文中 because 与 so 不能在同一句话中同时使用（中考高频改错/单选考点）
时间介词小结：on + 星期几（on Monday），at + 具体时刻，from...to...（从……到……）
形容词性物主代词与 favorite 连用表达“最喜欢的……”及科目名词首字母大写规范（P.E., Chinese, English）
key_vocab: favorite adj.&n. 特别喜爱的（人或事物）
useful adj. 有用的；有益的
key_patterns: What's your favorite subject? My favorite subject is science.
Why do you like P.E.? Because it's fun.
Who is your music teacher? My music teacher is Ms. Xie.

units.title: Can you play the guitar?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 个人特长与社团选择
units.grammar_focus: 情态动词 can 的基本用法
grammar_points: 情态动词 can 表能力，无人称和数变化，后必须接动词原形（can + do）
can 的否定式 can't（cannot）及一般疑问句 Can...? 的肯否定回答
乐器前加定冠词 the（play the guitar / piano），球类/棋类前不加冠词（play chess / soccer）
高频动词辨析：speak（说某种语言）、tell（讲故事/告诉）、talk（交谈）、say（说具体内容）
key_vocab: dance v. 跳舞 n. 舞蹈
speak v. 说（某种语言）；说话
show n. 演出；节目 v. 给……看；展示
key_patterns: Can you swim? Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
What club do you want to join? I want to join the music club.
Are you good with old people?

units.title: What time do you go to school?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 日常作息与时间管理
units.grammar_focus: What time / When 询问时间与频度副词
grammar_points: What time（提问具体时刻）与 When（提问时间段或具体时刻）的辨析与用法
时刻表达法：顺读法（six thirty）与逆读法（half past six, a quarter to seven）
常见频度副词（always, usually, often, sometimes, never）在句中的位置：be 动词/助动词后，实义动词前
either...or...（要么……要么……）连接并列主语时的“就近原则”
key_vocab: usually adv. 通常地；一般地
quarter n. 一刻钟；四分之一
clean v. 打扫；弄干净 adj. 干净的
either adv. 或者；也（用在否定词组后）
taste v. 有……的味道；品尝 n. 味道
key_patterns: What time do you usually get up? I usually get up at six thirty.
When does Scott go to work? He always goes to work at eleven o'clock.
I either watch TV or play computer games.

units.title: How do you get to school?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 出行方式与交通距离
units.grammar_focus: How / How long / How far 特殊疑问句与交通表达
grammar_points: 交通方式多样表达：take the + 交通工具（动词短语）与 by + 交通工具（介词短语，不加冠词）的同义转换
How（方式）、How long（多长时间，答语常用 for + 时间段）、How far（多远距离）三大疑问词辨析
花费时间固定句型：It takes sb. some time to do sth.（中考必考 it 作形式主语）
hundred 的用法：具体数字后不加 s（two hundred），表约数时用 hundreds of
key_vocab: ride v. 骑 n. 旅程
key_patterns: How do you get to school? I ride my bike. / By bike.
How long does it take to get to school? It takes about 15 minutes.
How far is it from your home to school? It's only about two kilometers.

units.title: Don't eat in class.
units.topic: 人与社会 · 校规班纪与规则意识
units.grammar_focus: 祈使句肯定/否定与情态动词 have to / must
grammar_points: 祈使句结构：动词原形开头表指令/请求，否定祈使句在句首加 Don't（Don't + 动词原形）
Be + 形容词构成的祈使句（Be quiet!）与 No + V-ing / 名词构成的警示牌语
must（主观“必须”，无人称变化）与 have to（客观“不得不”，有人称和时态变化）的中考辨析
mustn't（禁止）与 don't have to（不必）在否定回答中的核心区别
key_vocab: outside adv. 在外面 adj. 外面的
strict adj. 严格的；严厉的
key_patterns: Don't run in the hallways.
Can we wear a hat in class? No, we can't.
We must be on time. / We have to wear the school uniform.

units.title: Why do you like pandas?
units.topic: 人与自然 · 动物特征与濒危保护
units.grammar_focus: Why / Where 疑问句与描述性形容词
grammar_points: Why do/does...like...? 提问原因及 Because they're kind of... 回答
Where are...from? 与 Where do...come from? 的同义转换（be from = come from）
程度副词 kind of（有点儿）与名词短语 a kind of（一种）的区分
否定疑问句 Why don't you...?（为什么不……呢？）表建议及 be in great danger 等保护动物表达
key_vocab: cute adj. 可爱的；机灵的
shy adj. 羞怯的；腼腆的
key_patterns: Why do you like pandas? Because they're kind of interesting.
Where are lions from? They're from South Africa.
We must save the trees and not buy things made of ivory.

units.title: I'm watching TV.
units.topic: 人与自我 · 居家日常与即时活动
units.grammar_focus: 现在进行时（am / is / are + V-ing）
grammar_points: 现在进行时结构“be (am/is/are) + 动词现在分词（V-ing）”，表示此刻或现阶段正在进行的动作
动词现在分词变化规则：直接加 -ing；去哑 e 加 -ing（make→making）；重读闭音节双写尾字母加 -ing（run→running, swim→swimming）
现在进行时标志词（now, look, listen）及一般疑问句、特殊疑问句转换
一般现在时（经常性习惯）与现在进行时（正在发生）的对比辨析
key_vocab: drink v. 喝 n. 饮料
tomorrow adv. 在明天 n. 明天；未来
shop v. 购物 n. 商店
miss v. 怀念；思念；错过
delicious adj. 可口的；美味的
key_patterns: What are you doing? I'm watching TV.
Is she reading a newspaper? Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
He's using the computer now.

units.title: It's raining!
units.topic: 人与自然 · 天气变化与季节气候
units.grammar_focus: 询问天气句型与现在进行时拓展应用
grammar_points: 询问天气的两种高频同义句型：How's the weather (in...)? = What's the weather like (in...)?
天气构词法：名词 + -y 构成形容词（rain→rainy, wind→windy, cloud→cloudy, sun→sunny, snow→snowy）
注意区分动词 It's raining / snowing（正在下……）与形容词 It's rainy / snowy（多雨/多雪的）
电话交际与寒暄用语：How's it going? / Could you just tell him to call me back?
key_vocab: rain v. 下雨 n. 雨水
snow v. 下雪 n. 雪
key_patterns: How's the weather in Beijing? It's sunny.
How's it going? Not bad, thanks.
Could you tell him to call me back?

units.title: Is there a post office near here?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 社区环境与问路指路
units.grammar_focus: There be 存在句与方位介词短语
grammar_points: There be 句型结构（There is / are + 主语 + 地点），一般疑问句将 is/are 提前，否定句加 not
中考核心考点：There be 句型的“就近原则”（be 动词单复数由最靠近它的主语决定）
There be（客观存在“某地有……”）与 have/has（所属关系“某人拥有……”）辨析
方位介词及短语：across from（在……对面）、next to（紧挨着）、between...and...（在……和……之间）、in front of
key_patterns: Is there a bank near here? Yes, there is. It's on Center Street.
Where's the hotel? It's across from the bank.
Go along New Street and turn right at the first crossing.

units.title: What does he look like?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 人物外貌与特征描述
units.grammar_focus: 描述外貌句型与选择疑问句
grammar_points: 询问外貌句型：What do/does + 主语 + look like?（注意与询问性格 What is...like? 区分）
描述外貌动词搭配：is + 形容词/身高体型短语（be of medium height），has + 头发/五官名词（has short curly hair）
多个形容词修饰名词的语序规则（长短/大小 + 形状 + 颜色，如 long straight black hair）
选择疑问句（Is he tall or short?）不能用 Yes/No 回答，须直接选择其一
key_patterns: What does your friend look like? She's of medium height.
Does he have straight or curly hair? He has curly hair.
Each of them has a different idea.

units.title: I'd like some noodles.
units.topic: 人与社会 · 餐饮点单与饮食文化
units.grammar_focus: would like 用法与 some / any 及名词量化
grammar_points: would like（想要，缩写为 'd like）后接名词、to do 不定式或 sb. to do sth.，比 want 更委婉
Would you like...? 表征询或邀请时，句中用 some 不用 any；肯定回答常用 Yes, please. 否定用 No, thanks.
可数名词与不可数名词的数量表达（a large bowl of beef noodles, some mutton）
不同国家生日饮食文化与“The number of...（……的数量，谓语用单数）”和“a number of（许多，谓语用复数）”辨析
key_vocab: special n. 特色菜；特价品 adj. 特别的；特殊的
would modal v. （表示意愿）愿意
popular adj. 受欢迎的；普遍的
key_patterns: What would you like? I'd like beef and tomato noodles.
What size would you like? I'd like a medium bowl, please.
Are there any vegetables in the beef soup?

units.title: How was your school trip?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 研学旅行与过去经历
units.grammar_focus: 一般过去时（一）：be 动词与实义动词过去式
grammar_points: 一般过去时概念：表示过去某个时间发生的动作或存在的状态，常与 yesterday, last week, ...ago 连用
be 动词过去式（am/is → was；are → were）及其否定与疑问句转换
规则动词过去式变化规律（-ed / -d / 双写 + -ed / 辅音+y 变 i + -ed）及常见不规则动词（go→went, see→saw, feed→fed）
含实义动词的一般过去时疑问/否定须借助助动词 did（did/didn't 后动词必须用原形）
key_vocab: farm n. 农场 v. 务农；种田
grow v. 种植；生长；发育
excellent adj. 极好的；优秀的
exciting adj. 使人兴奋的；令人激动的
cheap adj. 廉价的；便宜的
key_patterns: How was your school trip? It was great!
Did you see any cows? Yes, I did. I saw quite a lot.
Luckily, it didn't rain, and the sun came out again.

units.title: What did you do last weekend?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 周末活动与户外见闻
units.grammar_focus: 一般过去时（二）：特殊疑问句与不规则过去式
grammar_points: 一般过去时的特殊疑问句结构：疑问词 + was/were...? 或 疑问词 + did + 主语 + 动词原形...?
Who 对主语提问时，语序为陈述语序且不加 did（Who visited her grandma?）
高频不规则动词过去式拓展（put→put, wake→woke, fly→flew, swim→swam, feel→felt）
感官动词 see/hear/watch + sb. + doing sth.（看见某人正在做某事）与 so...that... 初步感知
key_vocab: tired adj. 疲倦的；疲劳的
surprise n. 惊奇；惊讶 v. 使吃惊
key_patterns: What did you do last weekend? I went boating with my friends.
Who visited her grandma? Becky did.
I was so scared that I couldn't move.

units.title: Where did you go on vacation?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 假期旅行与游记记录
units.grammar_focus: 复合不定代词与一般过去时综合运用
grammar_points: 复合不定代词（someone/anyone/everyone/no one；something/anything/nothing）的肯否定及疑问句分配规则
中考高频考点：形容词修饰复合不定代词必须后置（something interesting, anything special）
复合不定代词作主语时，谓语动词一律用单数形式（Everyone is here.）
反身代词（myself, yourself）与 seem to do / seem + adj.、decide to do、feel like doing 搭配
key_vocab: wonderful adj. 精彩的；绝妙的
nothing pron. 没有什么；没有一件东西
everyone pron. 每人；人人；所有人
seem v. 好像；似乎；看来
bored adj. 厌倦的；烦闷的
key_patterns: Where did you go on vacation? I went to the mountains.
Did you buy anything special? Yes, I bought something for my father.
Everything tasted really good!

units.title: How often do you exercise?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 生活习惯与健康作息
units.grammar_focus: How often 提问频率与频率副词/次数短语
grammar_points: How often（提问频率，答语为 once a week, hardly ever 等）与 How many times（提问次数）辨析
频率副词梯度排序：always > usually > often > sometimes > hardly ever > never
中考核心辨析：hard（努力地；困难的）与 hardly（几乎不，含否定意义）的区别
让步连词 although 与 but 不能连用；percent 作主语时谓语动词由 of 后的名词单复数决定
key_vocab: housework n. 家务劳动；家务事
hardly adv. 几乎不；几乎没有
ever adv. 在任何时候；从来；曾经
health n. 健康；人的身体（或精神）状态
although conj. 虽然；尽管；即使
key_patterns: How often do you exercise? I exercise three times a week.
What does she usually do on weekends? She sometimes goes shopping.
Although many students like to watch sports, game shows are the most popular.

units.title: I'm more outgoing than my sister.
units.topic: 人与社会 · 人物性格与友谊观念
units.grammar_focus: 形容词与副词的比较级及同级比较
grammar_points: 形容词/副词比较级构成：单音节/部分双音节词加 -er/-r/双写+-er/变y为i+-er；多音节词前加 more；不规则变化（good/well→better）
比较级核心句型：A + be/实义动词 + 比较级 + than + B；修饰比较级的程度副词（much, a little, even, a lot）
同级比较结构：as + 形容词/副词原级 + as，否定形式为 not as/so + 原级 + as
特殊比较结构：the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...（越……越……）与 比较级 + and + 比较级（越来越……）
key_vocab: outgoing adj. 爱交际的；友好的；外向的
better adj.&adv. 较好的（地）；更好的（地）
loudly adv. 喧闹地；大声地；响亮地
hard-working adj. 工作努力的；辛勤的
talented adj. 有才能的；有才干的
care v. 在意；担忧；关心
serious adj. 严肃的；稳重的
necessary adj. 必需的；必要的
similar adj. 相像的；类似的
key_patterns: Sam has longer hair than Tom. / Tina is more outgoing than Tara.
Does Tara work as hard as Tina? Yes, she does.
A true friend reaches for your hand and touches your heart.

units.title: What's the best movie theater?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 城市设施与生活评价
units.grammar_focus: 形容词与副词的最高级
grammar_points: 最高级构成规律（-est 与 the most...）及不规则变化（good/well→best, bad/badly→worst, far→farthest/furthest）
最高级标志：in + 范围（in town）或 of + 同类复数（of the three），形容词最高级前一般加定冠词 the
中考高频句型：one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词（最……之一，作主语谓语用单数）
比较级表示最高级含义转换：比较级 + than any other + 单数名词（= the + 最高级）
key_vocab: comfortable adj. 使人舒服的；舒适的
cheaply adv. 便宜地；低廉地
carefully adv. 细致地；小心地；谨慎地
creative adj. 有创造力的；创造性的
seriously adv. 严重地；严肃地；认真地
key_patterns: What's the best movie theater to go to? Town Cinema. It's the closest to home.
You can buy tickets the most quickly there.
Talent shows are getting more and more popular.

units.title: Do you want to watch a game show?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 影视文化与媒体偏好
units.grammar_focus: 动词不定式（to do）作宾语与询问观点
grammar_points: 只能接动词不定式（to do）作宾语的常见动词：want, plan, hope, expect, decide, learn, try 等
接动名词（V-ing）作宾语的动词与短语：mind（介意）、can't stand（不能忍受）、enjoy、finish
询问并表达看法核心句型：What do you think of...? = How do you like...? 及五级态度表达
高频词组辨析：find out（查明真相）与 find（找到）、look for（寻找）
key_vocab: news n. 新闻节目；新闻
mind v. 介意；对（某事）烦恼
educational adj. 教育的；有教育意义的
successful adj. 获得成功的；有成就的
key_patterns: What do you think of talk shows? I don't mind them. / I can't stand them.
What do you plan to watch tonight? I plan to watch Days of Our Past.
I hope to find out what's going on around the world.

units.title: I'm going to study computer science.
units.cn_title: 我打算学习计算机科学。
units.topic: 人与自我 · 职业理想与新年计划
units.grammar_focus: be going to 表将来计划与职业词汇构词
grammar_points: be going to + 动词原形：表示主观打算、计划做某事或有迹象表明即将发生的事
There is/are going to be... 构成一般将来时的存在句（注意不能用 There is going to have）
职业名词构词后缀规律：-er（driver, writer）、-or（doctor, actor）、-ist（violinist, pianist, scientist）
时间/条件主将从现萌芽：when I grow up 从句用一般现在时，主句用 be going to
key_vocab: college n. 学院；大学；高等专科学校
university n. （综合性）大学；高等学府
promise n. 承诺；诺言 v. 许诺；承诺
key_patterns: What do you want to be when you grow up? I want to be an engineer.
How are you going to do that? I'm going to study math really hard.
Most of the time, we make promises to other people.

units.title: Will people have robots?
units.cn_title: 人们将会拥有机器人吗？
units.topic: 人与社会 · 未来科技与环境展望
units.grammar_focus: 一般将来时 will + do 与 more / less / fewer 比较
grammar_points: 一般将来时结构：will + 动词原形（否定 won't，疑问 Will...?），无人称变化，预测未来变化
There will be... 存在句将来时（不可用 There will have），常配 in + 时间段（表示“在……之后”，用 How soon 提问）
中考高频数量比较词区分：more（修饰可数复数或不可数）、fewer（仅修饰可数名词复数）、less（仅修饰不可数名词）
be going to（主观事先计划）与 will（客观预测或临时决定）的语义差异
key_vocab: believe v. 相信；认为有可能
possible adj. 可能存在或发生的；可能的
key_patterns: Will people use money in 100 years? No, they won't. Everything will be free.
There will be more pollution and fewer trees.
What will the future be like? Cities will be more polluted.

units.title: How do you make a banana milk shake?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 食物制作与劳动实践
units.grammar_focus: 祈使句表步骤与 How many / How much 区分
grammar_points: 用祈使句及顺序连接词（First, Next, Then, Finally）有条理地描述食物制作过程
How many + 可数名词复数 与 How much + 不可数名词 的提问及量词搭配（two spoons of honey）
可数名词与不可数名词在食物原料语境中的系统归类与转化
高频动词短语：turn on / off（开关电器）、pour...into...、fill...with...、cover...with...
key_vocab: traditional adj. 传统的；惯例的
key_patterns: How do you make a banana milk shake? First, peel the bananas.
How many bananas do we need? We need three bananas.
How much yogurt do we need? We need one cup of yogurt.

units.title: Can you come to my party?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 发出邀请与礼貌婉拒
units.grammar_focus: 情态动词 can / must / might 与邀请交际用语
grammar_points: 发出、接受与委婉拒绝邀请的规范表达：Can you...? / Sure, I'd love to. / Sorry, I can't. I have to...
情态动词表推测与义务：must（必须）、might（可能，语气比 may 更不确定）、have to（不得不）
高频时间连词与介词：until（直到……为止；not...until 直到……才，中考高频考点）
核心短语：prepare for、hang out、look forward to doing（注意 to 是介词，后接 V-ing）
key_vocab: prepare v. 使做好准备；把……准备好
available adj. 有空的；可获得的
until conj.&prep. 到……时；直到……为止
forward v. 转寄；发送 adv. 向前；前进
without prep. 没有；不（做某事）
key_patterns: Can you come to my party on Saturday afternoon? Sure, I'd love to.
I'm sorry, I'm not available. I have to prepare for an exam.
I look forward to hearing from you all.

units.title: If you go to the party, you'll have a great time!
units.cn_title: 如果你去派对，你会玩得很开心！
units.topic: 人与自我 · 决策分析与问题求助
units.grammar_focus: if 引导的条件状语从句（主将从现）与情态动词 should
grammar_points: 中考核心必考：if 引导条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”原则（主句用 will + do / 祈使句 / 情态动词，if 从句用一般现在时表将来）
unless 引导条件状语从句（等价于 if...not“除非，如果不”），同样遵循“主将从现”
情态动词 should（应当、应该）提出建议：You should talk to your parents.
辨析 if 引导条件状语从句（如果，主将从现）与 if 引导宾语从句（是否，时态视实际情况而定）
key_vocab: meeting n. 会议；集会；会面
upset adj. 难过；失望；沮丧
key_patterns: If you go to the party, you'll have a great time!
What will happen if they have the party today? Half the class won't come.
Unless we talk to someone, we'll certainly feel worse.

units.title: What's the matter?
units.topic: 人与自我 · 健康急救与身体状况
units.grammar_focus: 反身代词与情态动词 should / shouldn't 提建议
grammar_points: 反身代词（myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves）的构成及固定搭配（hurt oneself, enjoy oneself, by oneself）
询问健康与突发状况常用句型：What's the matter (with...)? = What's wrong (with...)?
情态动词 should / shouldn't 后接动词原形，用于给出合理的健康或生活建议
中考易混短语：used to do（过去常常做）与 be used to doing（习惯于做）的对比
key_patterns: What's the matter with Ben? He hurt himself. He has a sore back.
What should she do? She should take her temperature.
He was not ready to die that day.

units.title: I'll help to clean up the city parks.
units.cn_title: 我将帮忙打扫城市公园。
units.topic: 人与社会 · 志愿服务与公益行动
units.grammar_focus: 动词不定式（to do）作宾语、目的状语与宾补
grammar_points: 动词不定式作目的状语（to cheer them up）、作宾语（volunteer to do）与作宾语补足语（ask sb. to do sth.）
中考高频动副短语（clean up, cheer up, give out, put off, set up）：代词作宾语必须放中间（cheer them up）
could 表委婉提出建议（You could visit the sick kids...）与 will 表意愿决心
make a difference to... 与 lonely（主观孤独感）vs. alone（客观独自一人）的词义辨析
key_vocab: volunteer v. 义务做；自愿做 n. 志愿者
notice n. 公告；通告；注意 v. 注意到；意识到
lonely adj. 孤独的；寂寞的
journey n. （尤指长途）旅行；行程
broken adj. 破损的；残缺的
key_patterns: We need to come up with a plan for the City Park Clean-Up Day.
You could help to clean up the city parks.
Mario believes it can help him to get his future dream job.

units.title: Could you please clean your room?
units.cn_title: 你能打扫一下你的房间吗？
units.topic: 人与自我 · 家务劳动与家庭责任
units.grammar_focus: Could 委婉请求与征询许可（Could you...? / Could I...?）
grammar_points: Could you please + 动词原形?（请求对方做某事）与 Could I + 动词原形?（征求对方许可），此处 could 不表示过去时，而是委婉语气
对 Could 问句作肯定/否定回答时，须用 can / can't（如 Yes, sure. / Sorry, I can't.），不用 could
高频词辨析：borrow（借入，borrow...from...）与 lend（借出，lend...to...）
neither + 助动词/be/情态动词 + 主语（表示“某人也不”）及 in order to（为了）接动词原形表目的
key_vocab: stress n. 精神压力；心理负担
key_patterns: Could you please take out the rubbish? Yes, sure.
Could I use your computer? Sorry, I'm going to work on it now.
The earlier kids learn to be independent, the better it is for their future.

units.title: Why don't you talk to your parents?
units.cn_title: 为什么不和你的父母谈谈呢？
units.topic: 人与社会 · 亲子沟通与同伴压力
units.grammar_focus: 提建议句型与 until / so that / although 状语从句
grammar_points: 多种提建议句型及转换：Why don't you do...? = Why not do...? / What about doing...? / You should do...
purpose 目的状语从句引导词 so that（以便、为了），与 so...that...（如此……以至于）辨析
although（尽管）引导让步状语从句不与 but 连用；until（直到……为止）时间状语从句
高频结构：allow sb. to do sth.（允许某人做某事）、instead of + 名词/V-ing（代替）
key_vocab: relation n. 关系；联系；交往
nervous adj. 焦虑的；担忧的
offer v. 主动提出；自愿给予
continue v. 持续；继续存在
key_patterns: Why don't you talk to your parents? That's a good idea.
You should call him so that you can say you're sorry.
Although she's wrong, it's not a big deal.

units.title: What were you doing when the rainstorm came?
units.cn_title: 暴风雨来临时你在做什么？
units.topic: 人与自然 · 突发天气与难忘事件
units.grammar_focus: 过去进行时（was / were + V-ing）与 when / while 引导时间状语从句
grammar_points: 过去进行时结构“was/were + V-ing”，表示过去某一时刻或某一时段正在进行的动作
中考必考对比：when 后可接瞬间动词（一般过去时）或延续性动词；while 后通常接延续性动词（常用进行时态）
两个过去动作同时持续进行时，主从句均用过去进行时（While Linda was sleeping, Jenny was helping Mary...）
高频词汇辨析：asleep / sleep / sleepy；rise（上升）与 raise（举起/筹集）
key_vocab: heavily adv. 在很大程度上；大量地
rise v.&n. 升起；增加；提高
realize v. 理解；领会；认识到
silence n. 沉默；缄默；无声
key_patterns: What were you doing at eight last night? I was taking a shower.
When the rainstorm came, I was waiting for the bus.
While Linda was sleeping, Jenny was helping Mary with her homework.

units.title: An old man tried to move the mountains.
units.topic: 人与社会 · 中外神话与寓言故事
units.grammar_focus: unless / as soon as / so...that 引导的状语从句
grammar_points: as soon as（一……就……）引导时间状语从句：主将从现或主过从过（叙述过去故事时主从句均用一般过去时）
unless（除非）引导条件状语从句，等价于 if...not，遵循主将从现
so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句（如此……以至于……）引导结果状语从句，可与 too...to... 或 ...enough to... 转换
感叹句初步接触（What a funny story!）及高频搭配 remind sb. of / that、instead of
key_vocab: weak adj. 虚弱的；无力的
silly adj. 愚蠢的；不明事理的
magic adj. 有魔力的；有神奇力量的
excite v. 使激动；使兴奋
brave adj. 勇敢的；无畏的
key_patterns: As soon as the man finished talking, Yu Gong said his family could continue to move the mountains.
Unless he can hide his tail, he cannot turn himself into a man.
Sometimes he can make the stick so small that he can keep it in his ear.

units.title: What's the highest mountain in the world?
units.cn_title: 世界上最高的山是什么？
units.topic: 人与自然 · 世界地理与自然奇观
units.grammar_focus: 大数字读法与形容词/副词比较级和最高级进阶
grammar_points: 大数字与长宽高深表达：数词 + 单位 + 形容词（8,848.86 meters high / 1,025 meters deep）
人口提问固定句型：What's the population of...?（用 large/small 修饰 population，不用 many/few）
比较级表示最高级含义的中考经典结构：比较级 + than any other + 可数名词单数（= the + 最高级）
倍数比较初步（many times more than）与 achieve / succeed / challenge 等话题词汇
key_vocab: population n. 人口；人口数量
ancient adj. 古代的；古老的
achieve v. 达到；完成；成功
nature n. 自然界；大自然
key_patterns: What's the highest mountain in the world? Qomolangma.
Qomolangma is higher than any other mountain in the world.
China has the biggest population in the world.

units.title: Have you read Treasure Island yet?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 经典文学与流行音乐
units.grammar_focus: 现在完成时（一）：already 与 yet 的用法
grammar_points: 现在完成时构成“have/has + 动词过去分词（done）”，表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果
副词 already（已经，常用于肯定句）与 yet（已经/还，用于疑问句和否定句句末）的核心区分
常见不规则动词过去分词记忆（read-read-read, find-found-found, write-wrote-written, see-saw-seen）
一般过去时（强调过去某时做了某事）与现在完成时（强调现在状态/结果，不与具体过去时间点连用）的辨析
key_vocab: classic n. 经典作品；名著
page n. （书刊或纸张的）页，面，张
modern adj. 现代的；当代的
key_patterns: Have you read Little Women yet? Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
Has Tina read Treasure Island yet? Yes, she has already read it.
Ever since then, she has been a fan of American country music.

units.title: Have you ever been to a museum?
units.topic: 人与社会 · 文化场馆与旅行见闻
units.grammar_focus: 现在完成时（二）：ever/never 与 have been to / gone to / been in 辨析
grammar_points: Have you ever been to...? 询问过去经历，否定回答用 No, I haven't. / I've never been there. / Me neither.
中考必考辨析：have/has been to（去过已回）、have/has gone to（去了未回，多用第三人称）、have/has been in（在某地待了多久）
副词 ever（曾经）、never（从未）位于助动词 have/has 之后、过去分词之前；before 置于句末
分数表达（分子基数词，分母序数词，分子>1分母加-s）与 whether...or... 引导的让步/选择表达
key_vocab: somewhere adv. 在某处；到某处
camera n. 照相机；摄影机
unbelievable adj. 难以置信的；不真实的
rapid adj. 迅速的；快速的
key_patterns: Have you ever been to a science museum? Yes, I've been to a science museum.
I've never been to a water park. Me neither.
Three quarters of the population are Chinese.

units.title: I've had this bike for three years.
units.cn_title: 这辆自行车我买了三年了。
units.topic: 人与自我 · 家乡变迁与物品记忆
units.grammar_focus: 现在完成时（三）：for / since 与延续性动词转换
grammar_points: for + 时间段（for three years）与 since + 过去时间点 / 一般过去时从句（since 2020 / since I was four）均用 How long 提问
中考核心难点：瞬间动词（buy, borrow, die, leave, begin）不可与 for/since 连用，须转换为延续性状态（have, keep, be dead, be away, be on）
since 引导时间状语从句遵循“主句现在完成时，从句一般过去时”
高频词辨析：among（三者及以上之间）与 between（两者之间）；regard...as... 与 consider doing
key_vocab: clear v. 清理；清除 adj. 清楚易懂的
own v. 拥有；有 adj. 自己的
consider v. 注视；仔细考虑
especially adv. 尤其；特别；格外
key_patterns: How long have you had that bike over there? I've had it for three years.
How long has his son owned the train and railway set? Since his fourth birthday.
As for me, I will not give up my old soft toys.
